investments.company_description: Lovable operates a software creation platform that lets people build applications without extensive technical training, using AI to generate apps from natural language. It is headquartered in Stockholm.

River AI is a full-stack AI research company building open-weight models whose weights are freely downloadable. Its first product, the River API, lets developers fine-tune open-weight models on their own data without needing a dedicated AI team or large-lab infrastructure.

Vals AI builds independent benchmarks and evaluations that measure how well large language models and AI systems perform on real, domain-specific professional tasks such as legal, finance, and tax work. It gives enterprises data to compare models and AI products before deploying them.

Flagler Health builds AI software for musculoskeletal care clinics that integrates with existing electronic medical records to automate patient triage, care management, patient outreach and call handling, and revenue cycle tasks like prior authorization, coding, and billing. It is used by thousands of providers across more than 36 states.
investments.sub_sector: AI clinical and administrative workflow software for musculoskeletal care

investments.company_description: FSH Technologies builds custom software for city and county governments, delivered in weeks rather than years on a shared underlying platform. It also operates a proprietary system to track and respond to government software RFPs at scale.
investments.sub_sector: GovTech / state and local government software

investments.company_description: Etched designs purpose-built inference chips and full rack-scale systems—including networking, switching, cooling, power, and software—optimized for running transformer-based AI models efficiently. It aims to maximize tokens produced per dollar and per watt for AI inference workloads.
investments.notes: Reported undisclosed, but the post contains $1 billion; verify against the source.
investments.sub_sector: AI inference chips and rack-scale systems

investments.company_description: Preview is an AI-native video creation and production platform for professional creators, combining a video timeline with an infinite canvas in a collaborative multiplayer workspace. It lets teams generate footage with any AI model while tracking characters, locations, props and the provenance of every asset.
investments.notes: Reported undisclosed, but the post contains $100M; verify against the source.
investments.sub_sector: Generative video creation and production tooling

investments.company_description: Corma is training a foundation model specialized for defensive cybersecurity, using large-scale reinforcement learning in simulated enterprise network environments. Its model powers an agentic 'Security Workforce' that detects, contains and remediates attacks across enterprise security tools.
investments.sub_sector: AI foundation model for defensive cybersecurity

investments.company_description: Etched designs custom silicon and cluster-scale systems purpose-built for AI inference, specializing in running transformer and other frontier model architectures. Its first-generation chip was taped out at TSMC and is shipping to early customers in 2026.

Bunkerhill Health builds a platform, Carebricks, that lets hospitals and health systems create and deploy AI agents for clinical, operational, and administrative tasks using data the hospital already generates. It originally focused on taking research AI models through validation and FDA clearance into bedside use.
investments.sub_sector: Clinical AI agents for health systems

investments.company_description: Sable builds an AI employee called 'Aidan' that runs customer calls on its own, using voice, video, real-time vision and live browser interaction to demonstrate and explain a company's product to prospects.
investments.sub_sector: AI sales agents / customer-facing AI employees

investments.company_description: Twin1 builds a governed context layer for enterprises by giving each knowledge worker a digital 'Twin' — a model of their expertise and judgment that answers colleagues' questions inside Slack, Teams, and email while respecting their privacy and permission preferences. Networked together, these Twins let people and AI agents query organizational knowledge without bypassing its owners.
investments.sub_sector: Enterprise knowledge management and AI governance
